market_summary: <cite index="2-1">The Fed raised its target range by 25 basis points to 3.75%–4.00% on September 16, 2026, marking a shift from the previous trend of falling rates that had put pressure on Singapore banks' net interest margins.

items.headline: Fed rate hike supports Singapore bank earnings
items.summary: Federal Reserve raised rates by 25bp to 3.75%-4.00%, providing relief to Singapore banks' net interest margins after years of compression. DBS, OCBC and UOB benefit from higher SORA rates.

items.headline: Jefferies initiates Singapore bank coverage with Buy on DBS
items.summary: Jefferies started Singapore bank coverage with Buy ratings on DBS and UOB, Hold on OCBC, citing scope for earnings and dividends to compound.

items.headline: UOB found 'grossly negligent' over Stamford Land rights issue
items.summary: UOB ordered to pay S$1.9 million after court found it was 'grossly negligent' in advising on a rights issue for Stamford Land.

items.headline: SGX CEO Loh Boon Chye's pay rises 7% to S$8.37m
items.summary: Singapore Exchange CEO's compensation increased 7.1% to S$8.37 million in FY2026 as exchange delivers standout year.

items.headline: Nvidia Q2 FY2027 earnings beat, revenue $96.2B up 106% YoY
items.summary: Nvidia reported Q2 revenue of $96.2 billion (up 106% YoY) with gross margin of 75%, continuing strong AI infrastructure demand momentum.

items.headline: Nvidia to acquire Hugging Face for $12.9 billion
items.summary: Nvidia agreed to acquire AI platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion, aiming to strengthen its position in open model AI ecosystem.

items.headline: Apple unveils iPhone 18 Pro, foldable iPhone Duo with A20 Pro chip
items.summary: Apple announced iPhone 18 Pro and foldable iPhone Duo on September 9 powered by A20 Pro, a 2nm chip—first smartphone using latest TSMC technology.

items.headline: Apple introduces C2 modem, reducing Qualcomm reliance
items.summary: Apple unveiled second-generation in-house C2 modem for iPhone Duo, 50% faster than previous modem and supporting 5Gmm, reducing dependency on Qualcomm.

items.headline: Apple releases iOS 27 with Siri AI integration
items.summary: Apple released iOS 27 on September 14 with new AI-powered Siri that can understand personal context from messages, email and photos.

items.headline: SEC approves Tesla retail shareholder voting program
items.summary: SEC issued no-action letter allowing Tesla to implement Issuer Voluntary Retail Voting Program (IVRVP) letting retail shareholders auto-vote with board recommendations.

items.headline: Meta stock rises as enterprise AI becomes fourth pillar
items.summary: Meta stock gained as enterprise AI emerges as significant revenue driver alongside advertising, emerging markets, and platform businesses.
